sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Poet in da Corner by Debris Stevenson revealed that acting in a theatre can have a lot in common with MCing in a club By 2018 I was in my third or fourth year professionally as a grime MC and producer. I was 27 and didn’t have any aspirations in theatre. But Debris Stevenson, a good friend of mine, asked me to help her write one of the first drafts of a song in her play Poet in da Corner . I did that and then she invited me to a table reading session at the Royal Court to read the part of SS Vyper [a pirate radio DJ]. The theatre’s artistic director, Vicky Featherstone, said: “You read it so well you may as well be in the play!” I thought she was joking, but the next week I was in rehearsal. for colored girls who have considered suicide / when the rainbow is enuf, with music by Jammz, is at the Yard theatre, London, until 17 October As told to Lindesay Irvine Continue reading...
